reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 20. Nay or No: 19. Not Voting: 0. Present or other: 1. Of 39 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 39 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 208 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text: On Friday, I joined local leaders for a legislative summit hosted by the Gilroy Chamber of Commerce to discuss my work to lower costs and strengthen our infrastructure so that Gilroy residents and businesses can thrive. https://t.co/PaSUaB7xtg
https://t.co/gKEIxYpaMS

I had a great conversation with @POLITICOLive at the @b20 Summit yesterday to talk about strengthening American scientific leadership and the future of Congress’ tech and science agenda. You can listen to our discussion below. https://t.co/9QfSvVNx4l
Today and every day, we remember all the veterans who stood up to protect our freedoms. Thank you for your courage and your sacrifice. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/hcq95BYmk2

An illegal and costly war in Iran. Extrajudicial killings in the Caribbean. The suppressing of free speech. This is Pete Hegseth’s legacy as Secretary of Defense.

I’m voting yes on his impeachment today. https://t.co/ZzCLNkAJnh

posts.text: Looks like President Trump didn't hear what voters were telling him. Stephen Miller is the mastermind behind the out-of-control, violent, and misguided ICE activities terrorizing communities around America. This unfortunate promotion won't shield Miller from congressional https://t.co/Idl95sUETe
We’re ready to get to work. I joined @KQED this morning to discuss House Democrats’ plans to deliver both affordability and accountability for the American people: https://t.co/ltekFrefh9

It was a pleasure to attend last week’s ribbon cutting for the @WiskAero Vertiport at Hollister Municipal Airport! This is one of the first vertiports of its kind in the nation, and I’m thrilled that the future of aviation is being developed right here in #CA18. https://t.co/3TmtjP3nG1
https://t.co/Y0MHRgSbz2 https://t.co/YDDTpgD6Mn

💵GREAT NEWS: This year, I secured $54,830,000 for flood protection upgrades along the Pajaro River!

I was proud to submit this as my largest community project request of the year and to celebrate today with leaders in Watsonville. As El Niño is expected to intensify in the coming months, this critical funding will help save lives and property.
🗳️ Election Day is tomorrow! If you encounter any issues at the polls, refer to these resources: https://t.co/Vw1KHMhZYf
It was a pleasure to visit @GavilanCollege in Gilroy this week to talk about their legislative priorities and to meet some wonderful folks in the nursing program! #CA18 https://t.co/GFCOpShVun

💧GOOD NEWS: @CityofSanJose just received a $3.14 million EPA grant to help strengthen its stormwater infrastructure and stop pollutants from entering SF Bay. I voted for the EPA funding bill this year, and I’ll continue to support projects that keep our water and air clean. https://t.co/J1frioeN0m

I’m deeply sad to hear about the passing of Dolores Huerta, a friend and legend in the farmworkers’ movement. Her work and her vision transformed our country, especially here in her home state of California. She embodied the spirit of the movement with her phrase that will live on for generations: Sí Se Puede.

May she rest in peace, and may her memory be a blessing to all who loved her.
🗳️ Election Day is just one week away! Democracy works best when we all participate, so please visit https://t.co/NdeA0y9vP9 to make a plan to vote on or before November 3rd. https://t.co/GY3lGO6PXd

As El Niño-powered storms increase rain, flooding, and mudslides over the next few months, it’s important that Californians be prepared. Visit https://t.co/Ff7V3WBltc to learn how you should stay safe before, during, and after a storm.

🚨NEW: @Rep_Whitesides and I have introduced the SHIELD Our Elections Act, a bill to prevent unlawful ballot seizures and empower state AGs and voters to protect against illegal election interference from federal officials. Congress needs to take this important step to safeguard our democracy. https://t.co/TGC7uRokyn

I had a wonderful time this week visiting the bioengineering labs at @Stanford to see some of the cutting edge research they’re doing on plant and fungal biotech. The work that’s being done here is an important part of maintaining America’s scientific and agricultural leadership. https://t.co/wUo8fjhruP

Donald Trump is terrified of voters holding his party accountable for enabling his disastrous policies. He lost dozens of lawsuits challenging his 2020 election failure, and I hope that this anti-democratic lawsuit is also laughed out of court. https://t.co/uJArvaCz3U

Today, my colleagues @RepKevinMullin, @RepHuffman, @aishabbwahab, and I conducted an unannounced visit to the detention facility being operated by CBP at SFO.

There have been reports of people being detained for multiple days in a facility not designed or equipped for that purpose.

We will continue conducting oversight visits and our work to ensure transparency and accountability.

I'm proud to share that I just received a 100% rating on the @HRC scorecard for the 119th Congress! I’ve supported LGBTQ+ rights throughout my public service career, and I’ll continue fighting for dignity and freedom for all Americans. https://t.co/3O5P7kuoos

posts.text: Just one more week left to submit entries for the Congressional App Challenge! I’m looking forward to reviewing all the innovative projects our brilliant #CA18 students have been working on. Learn more at https://t.co/5aMnDIj0jq https://t.co/o485GF5tMm

My San Jose office received a suspicious letter through the mail today. Law enforcement was immediately called. The investigation is ongoing. All of my staffers are safe. I will have more to say after the investigation is complete.
Statement from 43 Members of Congress from California regarding Trump’s attacks on Los Angeles and San Diego: https://t.co/5Yb2WirRSD

As a former immigration lawyer and law professor, I’m committed to finding solutions to make our system more efficient and reasonable. If you missed our conversation last night, don’t worry! You can watch here: https://t.co/Wx6QvzqLAu

Thank you to everyone who joined my fireside chat last night in Soledad to discuss immigration, especially our young leaders from the Greenfield Youth Council who read questions from community members! #CA18 https://t.co/4zcKq96EeP
Trump’s war spiked diesel to nearly $9 per gallon in California and now he invites Iran to "take out" LA and San Diego? He’s out of his mind. https://t.co/KDgfXjskP9

It’s no wonder why only 26% of Americans approve of Trump’s economy. His policies are taking us backward, and House Republicans are rubber stamping his agenda. It’s time to change direction and get the country back on track. https://t.co/FS8TC83FuR
See what else America could have if not for Trump’s backwards priorities: https://t.co/qTHO3VelQS

Trump’s vanity projects are expected to cost billions of dollars. Instead of building ballrooms and retrofitting his Qatari jet, that money could’ve:

🛒 Covered 1.8 million families’ groceries for the month
👩‍🏫 Hired 27,000+ new teachers
🏡 Built 4,000+ new homes

Did you know over $5 billion worth of America’s fruits and vegetables are grown in the Salinas Valley each year? I met recently with the @OrganicTrade Association to discuss how we can strengthen domestic organic supply chains and help #CA18 farmers thrive. https://t.co/9IB3uYXLW7

Foreign digital piracy costs the U.S. economy up to $71 billion and 560,000 jobs each year. I just introduced the bipartisan DEFEND IP Act, a smart, targeted way to fight piracy while protecting a free and open internet. I’m proud to be leading this legislation with @RepBenCline,

It was a pleasure to visit @HartnellCollege’s Child Development Center in Salinas to celebrate the $250,000 I secured to help renovate their outdoor learning environment. Thank you for such a warm welcome, and I can’t wait for the kids to enjoy this new space! https://t.co/eyX9d1O5q9

Great to meet with @SantaCruzMETRO to discuss their work to get folks where they need to go safely and efficiently. I voted for the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law that funded many of these projects, and I’ll continue to support investments that improve mass transportation. https://t.co/3mL8JyKHfS

Este 5 de Octubre, voy a tener un conversatorio con los residentes de nuestro districto. Esta junta se va a tomar a cabo en la Ciudad de Soledad donde hablaremos sobre temas de inmigracion. Pueden registrarse y enviar sus preguntas en https://t.co/0iEZraHNYN. https://t.co/PWaf79vxkl

OCT 5: I’ll be having an in-person fireside chat with #CA18 residents in Soledad focused on immigration issues. You can sign up and submit your questions at https://t.co/0iEZraHNYN. https://t.co/WbqkCNyf6E

I met with @TheRealANCOR to discuss improving care for people with intellectual/developmental disabilities. In Congress, I’m fighting to protect Medicaid for these individuals and support the community providers who care for them. https://t.co/7HAmD8vsTz
Watch the full speech: https://t.co/O7CqwtvZ7l

This is the last week that the House is in DC until November. Republicans aren’t using this valuable time to lower your costs, they’re instead picking a fight with California to help oil and gas companies. https://t.co/QG1VjryenA

California, today is National Voter Registration Day! Our democracy works best when everyone who is eligible participates, so please visit https://t.co/NdeA0y9vP9 today to check your registration and make a plan to vote. https://t.co/fOTJRrVvtX

¡Feliz Mes de la Herencia Hispana! Este mes, igual como todos, honramos las numerosas contribuciones que los latinoamericanos han hecho para fortalecer nuestras comunidades y nuestro país. https://t.co/GLkgvZSFsY
Happy Hispanic Heritage Month! This month and every month, we honor the many contributions Latino Americans have made to strengthen our communities and our country. https://t.co/1aOQQdIfNX

Farmers across California are being hit hard by the Iran War. The cost of diesel hit a record high last week, and California’s farmers on average spent $2,037 more this planting season than they did last year.

We can’t afford Trump’s disastrous war of choice. https://t.co/Klx1UtiEny

Yesterday, I attended the Patriot Day ceremony in San José alongside @SJFD, @SanJosePD, and @SCCoSheriff officers. We’ll never forget the bravery and sacrifice of 9/11 first responders as well as those from the Bay Area who crossed the country 25 years ago to help recovery. https://t.co/KRlqNdK6pC

Today marks 25 years since one of the darkest days in our nation’s history. May we never forget those who lost their lives on September 11th, and may we always remember the heroes who bravely responded in the wake of unimaginable tragedy. https://t.co/WRtYBEGKNR

🎉HAPPY BIRTHDAY, CALIFORNIA! 🎉

Today marks 176 years of statehood, and in that time, California has become a worldwide leader in science, technological innovation, agriculture, entertainment, and more. Here’s to many more years of Golden State greatness! https://t.co/zfJfR3mv3a

I’m joining a bipartisan group of 261 lawmakers on a brief urging the Supreme Court to oppose Trump’s lawless attempts to block mail voting. Trump just voted by mail last month - he shouldn’t get to obstruct this right for millions of Americans. https://t.co/AuePSP5fg6
